marcus.summary: MACD crossover (17/26/9) passes all three universe gates on the 48-instrument Nifty Midcap 150 universe. DSR-corrected average Sharpe is 0.0885 (nTrials=48), pass fraction is 89.6% (43 of 48 instruments show positive raw Sharpe), and all 48 instruments clear the 30-trade floor with a minimum of 52 trades. The midcap result is weaker than the large-cap baseline (DSR avg 0.2715 at nTrials=15) as expected from the heavier multiple-testing penalty, but the edge generalises across sectors. All five marginal-ADV instruments show positive raw Sharpe — none flagged for replacement.

decision_marks_pending: **Decision (nTrials for midcap DSR correction) — algorithm: experimental** The nTrials parameter for DSR computation is set to 48, equal to the number of instruments in the midcap universe. This is the same convention used for the 15-instrument large-cap sweep (nTrials=15). The multiple-testing penalty is heavier at nTrials=48: E[max SR] = 2.261 vs 2.123 at nTrials=15, which is why DSR avg drops from 0.2715 (large-cap) to 0.0885 (midcap) even though the raw Sharpe distribution across midcaps looks strong.

**Decision (marginal-ADV instruments included in gate computation, not excluded) — algorithm: experimental** All five marginal-ADV instruments (BHEL, SCHAEFFLER, EXIDEIND, NATIONALUM, SAIL) show positive raw Sharpe (0.21-0.47) and sufficient trade counts (55-63). Per the 2026-05-07 ADV floor decision, these were flagged for scrutiny but not pre-excluded. Since all show positive results and clean data, they remain in the eligible-for-walk-forward set.
